local_A1_parity_adapter.quotient_model: A1 = Spec C[x,y,z]/(xz-y^2) = C^2/{+-1}, with x=u^2,y=uv,z=v^2
local_A1_parity_adapter.resolution_chart: On the blow-up/resolution chart use x=s, y=s*t, z=s*t^2; the normalized pullback of the universal double cover is u^2=s, so it is branched along E:{s=0}.
local_A1_parity_adapter.branch_parameter: For a normalization branch q with contact order a=ord_tau(s)=I_q(Gamma,E), normalized pullback is w^2=tau^a*unit.
local_A1_parity_adapter.ramification_rule: a odd iff the induced degree-2 cover is ramified at q; a even iff it is locally split/unramified over C.
local_A1_parity_adapter.ramification_contribution: Each odd-contact branch contributes exactly 1 to deg Ram(D/N).
local_A1_parity_adapter.node_notation: nu^*E_i=sum_j a_ij q_ij; r_i=#j; q_i=# {j : a_ij odd}.

global_parity_consequences.multibranch_capacity_replay: baseline q_i=m_i mod2 gives Q=26; to reach Q>=186 needs extra >=160. Fourteen largest extra capacities m_i-(m_i mod2) sum to 152<160; fifteen largest sum to 160.

slack_parameterization.interpretation: Every surviving profile is assigned one of 41 integer slack states s; larger s means more node ramification and fewer higher-order contacts.

G0_inertia_structure.source_model: Stoll-Testa product model X: u^2=2xy, v^2=x^2-y^2, w^2=x^2+y^2 with G0=(Z/2)^3 acting by sign changes of u,v,w.
G0_inertia_structure.G0plus: even-sign subgroup of order 4; X/G0plus has genus 2 and Riemann-Hurwitz equality shows G0plus acts freely on X.
G0_inertia_structure.node_count_replay: For each single-sign involution: 8x8 fixed pairs in XxX, stabilizer order2, hence G0-orbit size4 and 64/4=16 quotient nodes; 3*16=48.
G0_inertia_structure.exact_missing_adapter: Map the retained 48 exceptional labels/order used by V6 pairings to the three 16-node single-sign inertia types.

component_stabilizer_refinement.etale_cover: P=XxX -> Y has group G0plus of order4 and is etale.
component_stabilizer_refinement.component: Let Ctilde be a connected component of the pullback of D to XxX and H<=G0plus its stabilizer; h=|H|=deg(Ctilde->D) is in {1,2,4}.
component_stabilizer_refinement.stabilizer_parity: h must be even, so h in {2,4}; h=1 is excluded.

h2_case.reason: For nontrivial H<=G0plus, X->X/H is etale degree2 and 2g(X)-2=8=2(2g'-2), so g'=3.

h4_case.boundary_s0: If s=0 (Q=186), necessarily alpha=beta=93 and both maps D->C2 are etale.

component_stabilizer_refinement.common_projection_ramification_conservat: If R1,R2 are ramification degrees of the two descended projection maps (to genus3 for h=2 or genus2 for h=4), then R1+R2=2Q-372=4s.

inertia_component_interface.principle: For a fixed connected component of the full pullback to XxX, ramified local inertia elements must lie in its stabilizer subgroup M<=G0.
inertia_component_interface.h2_implication: When h=2, M has order4 and M∩G0plus=H; therefore only a restricted subset (at most two) of the three single-sign node inertia types can ramify on that component.
inertia_component_interface.h4_implication: When h=4, the full stabilizer can be all G0, so all three node inertia types are allowed.
inertia_component_interface.decisive_next_test: Compute V6 contact/odd-contact capacity separately on the three exact 16-node inertia classes. If every allowed h=2 inertia subset has odd-contact capacity <188, h=2 is excluded; the same type ledger may further constrain h=4.
